set.body:
Add one pure density workload with fixed domain/grid/normalization/bandwidth and all grid values consumed. Compare only its own frozen absolute/scaling budgets; a plotting heatmap is not substituted for this estimand. Capture retained heap and allocation diagnostics separately from primary timing.

Bounded adapter slice using docs/plans/PYMOVEMENTS_PERFORMANCE.md and the PM3.2 collector. Acceptance: source/data/config-bound raw receipts for all declared scales and modes; deliberate wrong-output and failed-process cases rejected; no budget relaxation after results. Run relevant correctness checks. Split before implementation if more than roughly half a day. This adapter alone cannot close PM3.
set.title: PM3.12 Record density absolute and scaling budgets
